answer.book: Du Moulin's 1641 Latin history of the Scottish troubles (Rerum nuper in regno Scotiae gestarum historia, seu verius Commentarius), a narrative of the Scottish church and its National Synod of 1638-1640 with inserted documents, followed by the Scottish Church's letter to the Helvetic churches with its preface and an errata list.
